question: Me-Dum-Me-Phi is an ancestor-worship festival celebrated in the state of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Me Dam Me Phi is a festival celebrated in the state of Assam. 
 
• The Ahoms celebrate this festival in a common place to worship their ancestors on 31st January every year with all traditional costumes and fanfare.
 
• It is the most important Ancestor worship communal festival in the Ahom religion celebrated by the Ahom people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other festivals of Assam:**

 
 
• Kherai Puja of the Bodos, 
 
• Baikhu and Pharkantis of the Rabhas,
 
• Ali-ai-ligang and Parag of the Mishing tribe,
 
• Sagra-misawa wansawa and
 
• Laghun of the Tiwas.
